description: This is a Perl script named 'fixup-makefile.pl' used for modifying makefiles, specifically for adding, fixing hashes, or renaming variables within makefile scripts in the openwrt build system.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions and terminates the script if the command-line arguments are incorrect.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets internal state variables based on a variable name, parsing template and related variable information.

methods.name: check_context
methods.description: Determines whether the current line is within the relevant makefile definition context.
